blurb: Catherine the Great's private gallery, grown into one of the largest museums on Earth, in the Winter Palace of the tsars.

facts.t: In 1764 Catherine the Great bought 225 paintings from a Berlin merchant who could not pay his debts to Prussia. That purchase is taken as the founding of the Hermitage. She called it her hermitage because only a few friends were allowed in.

facts.h: The storming of the Winter Palace
facts.t: On the night of 7 November 1917 (25 October in the old Russian calendar), Bolshevik forces entered the Winter Palace and arrested the government sitting there. The palace has belonged to the museum ever since.
